baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَلَغَ بَيْنَ السَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Reaching an endpoint opens into an inter-barrier interval; on the nearer side of the two obstructions, finding turns terrain into an encounter with a bounded community.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a limit supplies the completed approach into the encounter zone.
The interval between two sides supplies the spatial pocket in which the encounter occurs.
Two obstructions that close a gap define the pocket's containing sides.
Finding supplies the transition from traversed terrain to a perceived human presence.
Nearness short of the farther limit locates the people on the accessible side of the obstructions.
A human collective, rather than an isolated person, makes the bounded place a social setting.

changed_reading.before: He arrived at two barriers and happened upon a people nearby.
changed_reading.after: He completed a route into a near-side inter-barrier pocket where the terrain itself frames the discovered people as a bounded community.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن دُونِهِمَا ... لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial phrase marks proximity that remains short of a limit, while the negated near-action marks comprehension that approaches but does not reliably complete; location and cognition therefore share a threshold structure.

activation_trace.role: Being near yet short of the limit supplies the spatial half of the doubled threshold.
Near-performance under negation supplies an action that approaches completion without securely crossing it.
Understanding speech is the cognitive crossing that remains nearly unrealized.
Audibly expressed speech supplies the material that should pass into understanding.

changed_reading.before: The people are near the barriers and are very poor at understanding speech.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages two incomplete crossings at once: a people positioned short of a spatial limit and understanding held just short of semantic completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same reach-find-people frame governs the western, eastern, and inter-barrier encounters. Because the third recurrence uniquely inserts enclosure and near-failed comprehension, those details become the contrastive problem of this encounter rather than incidental description.

activation_trace.role: The first completed arrival establishes the recurring encounter frame.
Repeated finding links perceived terrain and the discovered people in the first encounter.
The first discovered collective supplies the social slot repeated at the focus.
A second completed arrival confirms the frame as a sequence rather than a one-off formula.
The second finding preserves the transition from destination to human encounter.
The second collective confirms that each destination is characterized through a people.
At the third recurrence, comprehension supplies the distinctive capacity under pressure.

structural_cues: 18:86, 18:90, and 18:93 repeat حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ ... وَجَدَ ... قَوْمًا; only the third foregrounds an inter-barrier location and near-failed comprehension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a threefold formula with a marked third variation; I infer that the variation names this encounter's governing problem. A live alternative is that the recurrence is only itinerary syntax and carries no contrastive ranking.

changed_reading.before: The communication difficulty is one more fact about a newly found population.
changed_reading.after: Within a deliberate third encounter-frame, enclosure and difficult comprehension replace the earlier destinations' defining conditions and announce the problem that this episode must answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before each arrival, the traveler follows a sabab; its branch image as a rope or connection turns the route into a linked means. The isolated inter-barrier community is therefore reached through a connection, sharpening the paradox of access without easy mutual understanding.

activation_trace.role: Following or going in the wake of something supplies directed continuation into the focus encounter.
A rope-like link or connection supplies the means whose course reaches the enclosed people.
Arrival realizes the connection's endpoint at the inter-barrier site.

structural_cues: The compact clause ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا recurs at 18:85, 18:89, and 18:92 immediately before the three حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ arrivals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated following of a connection before arrival; I infer a route that creates access to an otherwise bounded population. The alternative is the ordinary sense of taking a road or means without any relational force.

changed_reading.before: The traveler simply reaches a remote enclosed place.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately followed connective means reaches the enclosed place, making physical access and semantic difficulty coexist rather than making the people wholly unreachable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people immediately produce a direct address and a structured offer of payment for a specified work. Their operative negotiation revises the focus from absolute linguistic incapacity to severe but traversable communicative friction, partial comprehension, or mediated exchange.

activation_trace.role: Understanding is the focus capacity whose degree is revised by what follows.
Expressed speech is the supposedly difficult channel tested by the next ayah.
Their utterance functions as negotiation over a concrete matter, demonstrating an operative speech channel.
A fee assigned to work gives the exchange a precise transactional structure.
Money paid on a defined basis supplies the proposed consideration for the barrier work.

structural_cues: 18:94 moves directly from قَالُوا and vocative address to a conditional proposal: payment in exchange for making a barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coherent proposal-speech after the near-negation of understanding; I infer that the difficulty is graded or overcome in the encounter. A live alternative is translation, gesture, or an unmentioned intermediary rather than direct mutual comprehension.

changed_reading.before: The people are effectively unable to understand any speech.
changed_reading.after: They face a high communication threshold, yet enough meaning crosses directly or by mediation for them to formulate a diagnosis, address the traveler, and negotiate a remedy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exchange moves from difficult speech into cooperative, demonstrable operations: help, fill the breach, bring masses of iron, and pour molten copper. Shared work becomes a practical grammar that carries intention across the verbal bottleneck.

activation_trace.role: Difficult understanding establishes the verbal bottleneck that practical coordination must cross.
Expressed speech supplies the initial channel whose function is extended by action.
Mutual assistance turns the encounter into coordinated participation.
Filling a breach supplies the shared task that converts the reported danger into a material objective.
Discrete gathered masses supply visible units that can be requested, brought, and placed.
Pouring by emptying a vessel supplies a demonstrable final operation.
Molten copper supplies the concrete material governed by the pouring command.

structural_cues: The command-action sequence أَعِينُونِي ... آتُونِي ... انْفُخُوا ... آتُونِي shifts rapidly from proposition to jointly executable operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commands, materials, and cooperative labor; I infer that visible action carries and verifies meaning where speech alone is difficult. The alternative is that ordinary verbal comprehension was already established before construction began.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely reports a language barrier before the engineering episode.
changed_reading.after: The language barrier generates the episode's mode of coordination: meaning is stabilized through shared handling, sequence, and material transformation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people's near-failure to cross from utterance into understanding is answered by the aggressors' complete failure to cross the finished barrier either over or through it. The episode thus mirrors a semantic boundary at entry with a material boundary at completion.

activation_trace.role: Negated near-performance supplies the incomplete semantic crossing at the episode's entry.
Understanding names the crossing that the people barely achieve.
Closing a gap supplies the material boundary against which the later inability is tested.
Capacity and ability are explicitly negated for both routes across the completed barrier.
The split branch's upward extension sharpens the attempted vertical crossing without replacing the capacity reading.
Rising over and gaining the upper hand supplies the blocked route above.
Piercing through to what lies beyond supplies the blocked route through.

structural_cues: The focus's لَا يَكَادُونَ is answered by 18:97's paired فَمَا اسْطَاعُوا and وَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two negated capacity constructions at opposite ends of the episode; I infer a designed semantic-material mirror. A live alternative is that the verbal parallel only reports two unrelated kinds of difficulty.

changed_reading.before: Poor comprehension and the later wall are separate facts.
changed_reading.after: The focus opens an episode organized by failed crossings: meaning barely crosses into understanding, while the completed defense permits no crossing above or through.

context_deltas.mechanism: The barrier response is named mercy but assigned an endpoint at a fixed promised time, when it will be demolished and leveled. This revises enclosure from a permanent solution into provisional care within a larger temporal limit.

activation_trace.role: The gap-closing barrier supplies the focus image whose apparent stability is temporally qualified.
Merciful tenderness classifies the protective work by its benefit to the enclosed people.
A promise fixed to a time supplies the barrier's external temporal limit.
Demolition until leveling supplies the stated reversal of the protective structure.
Reality-fixed truth makes the promised reversal certain rather than hypothetical.

structural_cues: 18:98 juxtaposes هَذَا رَحْمَةٌ with فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُ دَكَّاءَ and closes by affirming the promise as true.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, an appointed promise, and leveling; I infer that protection is deliberately provisional. The live alternative is narrower: the expiry belongs only to the engineered work, not to the two natural barriers or to boundedness as such.

changed_reading.before: The encounter at two barriers begins a permanent solution through stronger enclosure.
changed_reading.after: The encounter begins a merciful but time-bounded protection: enclosure answers the present danger without becoming the final order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets semantic branches of the spatial nouns echo the explicit comprehension clause. It remains anchored in بَيْنَ, السَّدَّيْنِ, يَفْقَهُونَ, and قَوْلًا and in their packet branches; downstream prose should present it as lexical mirroring, not as a claim that the mountains physically cause aphasia.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بَيْنَ السَّدَّيْنِ ... لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا

activation_trace.role: Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the semantic opening that communication ordinarily creates.
A defect that blocks expression supplies a semantic counterpart to the two physical obstructions.
Understanding is the obstructed reception of disclosed meaning.
Spoken utterance supplies the material whose passage into comprehension is blocked.

changed_reading.before: Physical barriers and a language problem merely happen to share the scene.
changed_reading.after: The focus may make the spatial enclosure echo inside communication itself: disclosure stands between parties, but a speech-blocking defect closes the semantic gap.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the packet's alternate ق ل ل mapping for قَوْلًا rather than replacing its ordinary speech sense. It remains anchored by the split inventory, the focus's near-negation, and the later negotiation; downstream prose must qualify it as an exploratory pressure toward a scant shared channel, not translate قَوْلًا as 'little.'

activation_trace.role: The alternate mapped branch contributes scarcity or smallness as pressure on the available shared speech channel.
Near-performance under negation keeps successful uptake rare and incomplete.
The subsequent negotiation shows that the channel is restricted rather than absent and contains the scarcity activation.

changed_reading.before: The deficit lies entirely in the people's ability to understand normal speech.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the shared channel itself may be scant: only a narrow amount or range of speech becomes mutually actionable at this boundary.

strongest_changes: The repeated reach-find-people formula makes 18:93 a contrastive third encounter whose defining problem is bounded, difficult communication.
The community's structured proposal in 18:94 revises near-failed comprehension from total muteness to severe but traversable friction or mediation.
The cooperative construction sequence turns visible labor into a practical grammar, and 18:97 mirrors the initial semantic threshold with an uncrossable material one.
The final designation of the work as mercy with a promised leveling makes protection beneficial but provisional.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses spatial, social, and semantic thresholds into one encounter: a connective route reaches people enclosed by barriers, speech nearly fails, action carries meaning, and the resulting physical closure later perfects the crossing-failure first heard in the comprehension clause.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether the successful exchange is direct, partial, gestural, translated, or otherwise mediated.
The semantic-sadd reading may be an intentional lexical mirror or only a productive branch resonance.
The promised leveling certainly qualifies the engineered work; whether it also reframes the two natural barriers or boundedness more generally remains open.
